initial.title: [v0.92][WP-18C.02d][112.d] Integrate Layer 8 authority and delivery states into Observatory
initial.goal: Present Runtime-owned Layer 8 authority, delivery, refusal, failure, recovery, and redacted correlation state in Observatory without browser authority.
initial.required_outcome: The actual Observatory consumes the terminal #270 served protocol and visibly distinguishes delivered, refused, and failed outcomes while retaining no private authority material.
declared_scope: Observatory adapter for the terminal #270 recipient-acknowledgement route
Real-browser and static contract proof over actual assets
authority_boundary: Browser holds no private key and performs no signing or policy decision
Runtime-provided signed request and acknowledgement may be forwarded only as opaque ephemeral POST input and must never render, log, cache, or persist
Only served redacted response fields may render
operator_constraints: Work only in the canonical bound FastWork worktree after fresh design approval
Do not touch stale #114 parent preparation or bind #114
initial.task_boundary: Implement only #271 Observatory presentation/adapter and its focused proof; #278 history restoration remains downstream.
dependencies: #278 remains downstream and blocked until #271 terminal
non_goals: Runtime authority or acknowledgement protocol changes
Browser signing, policy, or private-key storage
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: #112/#265/#270 terminal caches validate canonical and their merges are ancestral to the execution base.
AC-2: Observatory consumes only the served #270 response schema and never treats request acceptance as delivery.
AC-3: Delivered, refused, failed, revoked, and recovery states are distinct, visible, accessible, and action-safe.
AC-4: Raw correlation identifiers, signed messages, private keys, proof hashes, provider payloads, and policy details do not render or persist.
AC-5: Exact changed scope is limited to app.js, styles.css, the focused validator, and issue-local lifecycle/evidence surfaces.
AC-6: Real-browser focused proof, static contract proof, diff hygiene, and relevant format/lint checks pass.
AC-7: Fresh design review and fresh exact-head implementation review have no actionable findings before publication.
initial.plan_summary: Prove dependencies and collision-free scope, obtain fresh design authority, bind #271, implement the narrow served-protocol adapter and accessible state rendering, run exact browser/static proof, review, publish, and finish before #278 resumes.

steps.action: Validate terminal dependencies, current-main base, exact scope, and collision freedom.
Obtain fresh design review and bind #271 through typed v2 in FastWork.
Implement the Runtime-owned acknowledgement adapter and distinct accessible UI states within exact scope.
Run proof, fresh exact-head review, publication, CI, finish, and release #278 only after terminal ancestry.

invariants: Only Runtime status delivered is presented as delivery
Raw authority material and correlation identifiers never render or persist
risks: Historical candidate mocked conversation results rather than the terminal #270 endpoint
UI could confuse accepted with delivered
Fixture-only proof could miss actual asset wiring
Private response fields could leak into DOM text
stop_conditions: Any dependency cache is noncanonical or nonancestral
Any concurrent writer owns an exact changed path
Fresh review finds an actionable defect
Proof does not exercise the actual served response schema and actual Observatory assets
initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on unknown schema/status, malformed response, unavailable Runtime, redaction uncertainty, scope drift, or missing proof.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove canonical terminal dependencies, exact current-main base, every committed/staged/unstaged/untracked path, exact lock scope, and a deterministic packet ready for separate fresh review.

Invoke the real adl-runtime-kernel recipient-acknowledgement handler with the existing authentic signed request/acknowledgement pair and prove delivered, refusal, generation binding, and raw-correlation redaction before browser claims are reviewed.

Exercise actual Observatory assets in exactly eight nonzero cases: delivered; signed refusal; malformed response failure; unavailable Runtime recovery; revoked demotion; action release; keyboard/live-region accessibility; and forbidden-field non-disclosure. Unknown statuses and ignored/zero receipts must fail closed.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Deferred until bound implementation creates the exact validator target; it must consume authentic handler-derived public response fixtures rather than mocked conversation frames.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove exact changed paths and clean patch.

initial.review_scope: Exact #271 issue/prepared/evidence plus app.js, styles.css, and validate_layer8_authority_observatory_ui.sh.
review_prompts: Does the browser forward only Runtime-provided signed artifacts ephemerally to the actual #270 route without originating, verifying, rendering, logging, caching, or persisting them?
Does proof invoke the real adl-runtime-kernel handler with an authentic signed pair rather than mocked conversation frames?

Do exactly eight nonzero browser cases prove delivered, refusal, malformed failure, unavailable recovery, revoked demotion, action release, accessibility, and non-disclosure, with unknown/ignored/zero receipts failing closed?
Can any raw signed material, raw correlation ID, private key, proof hash, provider payload, or policy detail render or persist?
Does scope validation inventory committed, staged, unstaged, untracked, and exact lock paths and remain disjoint from #278/#114?
